about: Polyvoid: three levels (the Hollow Square, the Hex Warden, the Gauntlet of both) chosen on the title; bosses that evolve (one square -> four -> four with orbiting orbs; a hex that unfolds spikes), bullets, sweeping and wide lasers; an orbiting hero whose laser fires by itself and grows with grazes; almost no UI (score, lives, two rings, a life arc round each boss); music loops; all scene data: bodies, operators (input, actor, emitter, hud, fx, music) and Nod rules.

settings.text: x1: 8 cubes a turn of shield, x2: 4, x0.5: 16. Spiral off: the rings.

Separate: a hit on the ship costs a life. Tail first: the tail melts, then the lives; cubes heal first. Tail heals: hurt, the tail draws in and heals it - dim once it is gone. A hit on the ship costs the ratio x a stopped shot.
It trails the ship, then coils round it, and stops shots: each costs that much and sends a shockwave along it.

settings.label: Aim the Supernova (it follows the pointer)

settings.text: Hold: the tail is drawn in. Let go: a beam as strong as what you took. 2.5 turns or more: SUPERNOVA.

settings.label: Gun line round the ship (turquoise, from the nose: the gun's level)

settings.text: A beam on a boss knocks green cores off it: tail, and the gun grows - 1 dart, then 2, 3, 4, 5 (2, 5, 9, 14 cores). A hit costs levels.
The pieces the beam crosses light up, the bigger the beam the brighter; it breaks the shots it crosses and throws sparks.
A soft sound a shot, stacked, each a little different. 0: silent.

settings.label: Music disc (the notes on the floor)

settings.text: For trying things: off for a real game. Hold the game icon to hide or show its HUD.
Every glow leaves a streak under it, as a neon sign on wet asphalt.

settings.label: Close shave slow-mo (a shot grazes the ship)
Final forms: the ship may go back inward (over the ring it left)

settings.text: At 0 life the last boss of the run falls - and rises again, bigger: the arena opens a ring wider, the ship is pushed out, its shots grow. 0: none.
